line: I really go ku, new ice for the freezer
vault_lines: I really go ku, new ice for the freezer
meaning:
“Go kuu” is just slang for “go crazy,” but this is clearly wordplay on the name of the character “Goku,” while “Freezer” is meant to reference the character “Frieza,” both of whom are from the iconic anime series “Dragon Ball,” with Goku being the main protagonist, and Frieza being one of the major antagonists.



Goku (Left) and Frieza (Right) in Dragon Ball Z (Frieza Saga)

Vegeta is a major character from the very renowned anime series “Dragon Ball,” which is mostly known for its iconic and intense battles. M Row is using Vegeta as an example of how he’d beat his enemies in hand-to-hand combat without much trouble.
